posts.text: It can be found in this cave. I’ve marked it on your map.

Senators and Representatives should be required to hold the Staff of the Inquisitor when addressing the assembly

(In part because if we locate the legendary staff before they do, they wouldn't be able to speak again)
Got that DAWG in me (I'm sleepy and would like to lay down in a sunbeam)

I hear The Cain Rap playing in my head virtually every day

“Give it up for the Horadrim!”
I try to keep an open mind and yet I still have trouble getting behind the Decorative Towel mentality
Gonna start asserting "the era of AGI has arrived" in response to every mundane thing I encounter throughout my day

I played so damn much fire emblem through the GBA GameCube tv adapter thing 

Good shit
Like when a developer says “we can make this boss harder by tripling their health and adding insta-kill moves in their second health bar

One thing I can’t stand tho is when people defend obviously bad game design by telling the OP to get gud

Like it’s kinda funny for a Dark Souls-ish game where that’s the point, but sometimes game design is actually Just Bad

It’s actually kinda funny though because I’ve found a few threads where there’s an account or two obviously trying to Be That Guy and everyone else is just ignoring their posts and staying on topic, so they chime in again just to make sure we all know they’re a Big Boy Gamer

It's 2026 and when I look up strategy discussions on gaming forums it's still

"Hey, this fight seems weirdly hard for where it's at. Am I missing something or is this intentionally hard?"

"Hah! You think that's hard?? I can beat that fight no problem"

Pull up to a red light

🎵 what a thrill… 🎵
Gonna rig my car so that instead of the stupid engine auto-shutoff at stoplights, it starts playing the Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater theme
I don't even like being in regular traffic let alone doing it with humans
(I know a few places that are actually good but nothing within stumbling distance unfortunately)
